title: Ontology Suite severity policy
description: The severity each check is reported at, per stage of the project. The same file as the Python suite's --severity-policy. Applied by Run Local Checks and Run Deep Validation; ontologySuite.stringency picks the stage. A file with no 'stages' is a single stage.

target.description: The severity to report this check's findings at in this stage, or 'off' to leave the check out of this stage.

extends.description: Another stage of this file to start from; the entries here are applied on top of it.

CNF-001.description: Class used but not declared in the ontology. Declared Warning.

CNF-002.description: Property used but not declared in the ontology. Declared Warning.

CNF-005.description: Ontology class never populated. Declared Info.

DAT-001.description: Literal lexical form invalid for its datatype. Declared Violation.

DAT-004.description: gist:Magnitude without a unit of measure. Declared Violation.

EFF-001.description: Class hierarchy chain too deep. Declared Warning.

EFF-003.description: Excessive property fan-out on a single subject. Declared Info.

LOG-001.description: Class disjoint with its own ancestor. Declared Violation.

LOG-002.description: owl:FunctionalProperty violated by data. Declared Violation.

LOG-003.description: Redundant equivalentClass + subClassOf pair. Declared Warning.

LOG-004.description: Property has more than one inverse. Declared Violation.

LOG-005.description: Property declared inverse of itself. Declared Violation.

LOG-006.description: Symmetric property has unequal domain and range. Declared Violation.

LOG-007.description: Transitive property has unequal domain and range. Declared Violation.

MAL-001.description: Qualified cardinality written as unqualified. Declared Violation. Reported by this extension only: the Python suite refuses it in a policy.

MAL-002.description: Restriction on more than one property. Declared Violation. Reported by this extension only: the Python suite refuses it in a policy.

MAL-003.description: IRI with no scheme. Declared Violation. Reported by this extension only: the Python suite refuses it in a policy.

MDL-001.description: Named inverse property (consider a SPARQL property path instead). Declared Hint. Reported by this extension only: the Python suite refuses it in a policy.

MDL-002.description: owl:equivalentClass between two named classes with no logical definition. Declared Hint. Reported by this extension only: the Python suite refuses it in a policy.

MDL-003.description: Consider gist:Category instead of a new owl:Class. Declared Hint. Reported by this extension only: the Python suite refuses it in a policy.

PRJ-REQUIRED.description: Missing required predicate (project rule). Declared Warning. Reported by this extension only: the Python suite refuses it in a policy.

QUA-001.description: Class or property missing rdfs:label. Declared Warning.

QUA-002.description: Ontology missing versioning/title metadata. Declared Info.

QUA-003.description: Deprecated term still in active use. Declared Warning.

QUA-005.description: Ontology has no identifying IRI at all. Declared Warning.

QUA-006.description: Ontology IRI reused as the namespace IRI for its own concepts. Declared Warning.

QUA-008.description: Ontology or version IRI does not use the https:// scheme. Declared Warning.

QUA-009.description: Class or property without one skos:prefLabel per language. Declared Warning.

QUA-010.description: Class or property without a skos:definition. Declared Warning.

REA-001.description: Individual in two disjoint classes (post-closure). Declared Violation.

REA-002.description: Asymmetric property holds in both directions. Declared Violation.

REA-003.description: Irreflexive property asserted as a self-loop. Declared Violation.

REA-004.description: Individual inferred to be a member of owl:Nothing. Declared Violation.

REA-005.description: Individual both owl:sameAs and owl:differentFrom the same node. Declared Violation.

REA-010.description: Ontology exceeds the OWL2 EL profile. Declared Info.

REA-011.description: Ontology exceeds the OWL2 QL profile. Declared Info.

REA-012.description: Ontology exceeds the OWL2 RL profile. Declared Info.

REA-020.description: Ontology found inconsistent by an external DL reasoner. Declared Violation.

REA-021.description: Class found unsatisfiable by an external DL reasoner. Declared Violation.

REA-022.description: External DL reasoner unavailable -- only owlrl-based checks ran. Declared Info.

STR-001.description: Undefined class used as rdf:type. Declared Violation.

STR-003.description: Property missing both domain and range. Declared Warning.

STR-004.description: Class has no formal definition. Declared Warning.

STR-005.description: Property domain value has no declared type. Declared Violation.

STR-006.description: Untyped object of a triple. Declared Violation.

STR-007.description: Predicate has no declared rdf:type. Declared Violation.

STR-008.description: Property range value has no declared type. Declared Violation.

STR-009.description: Untyped subject of a triple. Declared Violation.

STY-001.description: Class name not UpperCamelCase. Declared Warning.

STY-002.description: Property name not lowerCamelCase. Declared Warning.

STY-003.description: Label missing a language tag. Declared Info.

STY-004.description: skos:prefLabel does not match local name. Declared Warning.

STY-005.description: Inconsistent local-name separator style. Declared Warning.

TQL-001.description: Variable bound by structurally different expressions across queries. Declared Warning.

TQL-002.description: Constructed-IRI variable used in CONSTRUCT but never bound. Declared Violation.

TQL-003.description: CONSTRUCT variable not bound in the query. Declared Info.

TQL-004.description: Constructed IRI variable never converted from a string. Declared Violation.

TQL-005.description: Datatype-suffixed variable never given a datatype. Declared Warning.

VOC-001.description: Undeclared term referenced by an axiom. Declared Warning.

additionalProperties.description: A check from a registry set in ontologySuite.checksRegistryPath. An id nothing reports is refused when the policy is applied.

stages.description: Named stages; the names are the project's own, e.g. sketch, draft, release.
